correctness.rationale: From actual RESULT.md proof, squaring permutes and Frobenius-squares supports injectively, forcing each source basis cycle either all zero or disjoint translated supports. If a nonzero source cycle of length m maps into a target cycle n, its support is invariant under +m and the m translates must be disjoint: gcd(m,n)=m and m|n. The support is exactly one residue class mod m, and any source cycle so used occupies the whole target cycle, precluding a second source-cycle component. A free residue class and λ^(2^n−1)=1 produce m gcd(q−1,2^n−1) choices. Different target cycles contribute independently, giving the product count. Linearly independent disjoint-support images give rank as sum of lengths of source cycles selected by at least one target; idempotent variables encode this exactly. Nonzero Hom existence iff some divisibility. Independence of field characteristic is valid for q=2 as well. Independently enumerated small complete matrices across 6 prime-field source/target choices and confirmed full rank histograms.
